When he passes by the vegetable garden, he finds the herb he can't find anywhere else, he is very excited, thinking that this piece of land is ownerless, so he picks the herb. Wang Xiao is Zhang Hua's apprentice, he sees Li Qing's behavior, but because he hears from the neighbors about Li Qing's mother's situation, he decides not to tell Zhang Hua. When Zhang Hua finds the herb is missing, he starts asking people around. In the end, Li Qing finds out that the vegetable garden belongs to Zhang Hua, so he goes to admit his behavior.

[Question]
What kind of emotion does Wang Xiao feel when he sees Li Qing picking the herb but does not tell Zhang Hua?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Wang Xiao possibly feels satisfied, as he helps Li Qing solve an urgent problem.
B. Wang Xiao possibly feels indifferent, as he thinks this is not his responsibility.
C. Wang Xiao possibly feels confused, as he does not know whether he should intervene in Li Qing's behavior.
D. Wang Xiao possibly feels conflicted and worried, as he is torn between respecting his master's property and sympathizing with Li Qing's predicament.
